meta.title: Remove an item from the cart with the trash icon

plan.title: Remove PR cart item with trash icon

steps.note: Open the purchase requisitions area where the PR cart is available.
Use an open PR, which is the eligible source for the cart flow.
Select a PR with at least two line items so one can be removed while another remains.

args.goal: in the buyer's purchase-request cart, click the trash icon next to one line item and stop with that item absent from the side panel and the item count visibly decreased by one

steps.note: Perform the cart-specific trash action and verify both the removed line and the decremented count on screen.
Confirm the cart removal completed without an application error.
